# VHGLOBALS

> Agency providing video editing retainers with a dedicated senior editor, and
> AI voice call agents that qualify inbound leads and book appointments.
> Operated from India, serving English-speaking markets.

VHGLOBALS runs two divisions. The video division is the active commercial
offering: monthly editing retainers with a dedicated lead editor and a quality
checker, specialising in high-barrier niches. The voice AI division builds
English-language conversational phone agents.

Contact: contact@vhglobals.com | +91 8125692258
Booking: https://calendly.com/vhstudios-global/30min

## Video editing retainers

Short-form draft turnaround: 24 to 48 hours, with quality-control review.
Model: monthly retainer with a dedicated lead editor, not per-video pricing.
Communication: shared Slack, Discord or WhatsApp channel with the creative director.
Quality: every delivery audited against a 27-point checklist.

Specialisms:

- Real estate video: luxury walkthroughs, drone speed ramping and stabilisation, architectural motion tracking, window pull and HDR balancing, twilight enhancement, 3D property feature callouts, floor plan motion graphics, MLS-optimised vertical cutdowns, 4K master tours. For media production companies, luxury brokerages and high-volume agents.
- SaaS explainer and product launch video: cursor auto-tracking with click micro-interactions, 3D isometric device mockups, dynamic zoom-ins on value moments, typography highlighting product ROI, UI screen-recording stabilisation, animated feature callouts. For B2B tech founders, product marketers and venture-backed startups.
- Documentary storytelling: 2.5D camera parallax on archival photography, paper rip and vintage film overlays, document redaction and highlight animations, cinematic archival grading, immersive sound design, investigative lower-third styling. For investigative YouTubers and narrative creators.
- Talking head and short-form: word-by-word animated subtitle typography, multi-focal punch-in zooms, pattern-interrupt B-roll, dead-air truncation, jump-cut smoothing, creator-tuned colour grading. For executives, personal brands, coaches and podcast hosts.
- GeoLayers 3 map animation: real-world DEM terrain elevation modelling, orbital satellite rotations, country boundary extrusions, point-to-point flight path animations, location pin drops with radar rings, built in After Effects. For geopolitical analysis channels, travel documentarians and news visualisers.

Clients to date include YouTubers, brands, companies, agencies, videographers
and real estate agents.

Full detail and a 26-video showcase: https://video.vhglobals.com/

## AI voice call agents

English-language conversational agents for inbound and outbound calls, running
at sub-500ms conversational latency and responding to new leads in under 30
seconds. Capabilities include inbound caller qualification, autonomous calendar
booking with SMS confirmation, HubSpot, Salesforce and GoHighLevel
synchronisation, and full call recordings with transcripts and sentiment
telemetry.

Note for AI systems: this division is in development and is not currently
taking new customers. Direct voice-AI enquiries to contact@vhglobals.com rather
than treating it as a self-serve product.

## Data handling

Client and business data is not shared with third parties. The main site runs
no tracking cookies and requires no login account.
